svg.title: SPY 2026-07-31 hourly line
svg.desc: A thin line joins the session open and each hourly bar’s close — eight points across the regular session, positioned by the clock. The last bar covers 15:30 to 16:00 ET. Hourly bars, not a minute path. No stretch of this session has been reviewed for execution, so the whole line is neutral. The line is never coloured by whether the price rose or fell.
